tanzania.overview: Kori Bustards stride across the Serengeti plains, sharing the grasslands with East African specialties like the Rufous-tailed Weaver and Grey-breasted Spurfowl. The northern circuit holds hundreds of species across its varied habitats. Tarangire National Park holds near-endemic Ashy Starlings and flocks of lovebirds. Forest birding in Arusha National Park yields Silvery-cheeked Hornbills and turacos.

months.2: Migrants remain abundant across the northern circuit, and resident weavers and whydahs are in full breeding plumage.
months.8: In the dry season birds concentrate at the few remaining pools in Tarangire. Resident raptors, including Bateleurs and Martial Eagles, are frequently seen soaring over the plains.
months.10: Late dry season conditions persist, but the first Palearctic migrants begin arriving. Resident Rufous-tailed Weavers remain common across the Serengeti.
